title: Soft ground invites another pass
literal_meaning: When they find it soft, they plough it a second time.
explanation: The source places this line under “soft”, while the linked word dohada means a second tilling. That gives the saying a concrete repeated action: easy ground invites another pass of the plough. An editorial social reading hears a warning about someone taking further advantage when another person yields. It is a possible application of the image, not a separate traditional-use gloss supplied by this entry. The line need not make kindness a fault; the question is whether a concession is being treated as permission to keep pressing.
meaning_odia: ନରମ ମିଳିଲେ ଆଉ ଥରେ ଚଷନ୍ତି—ଏଠାରେ ଏକ କାମ ସହଜ ହେବାରୁ ତାକୁ ପୁଣି କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଅଛି। “ଦୋହଡ଼” ଅର୍ଥ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଥର ହଳ କରିବା ବୋଲି ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ ଅଭିଧାନ ଶବ୍ଦ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରେ। ଲୋକସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ଏହାକୁ ପଢ଼ିଲେ, ଜଣେ ଥରେ ଛାଡ଼ ଦେଲେ ଆଉ ଅଧିକ ଚାପ ଦେବାର କଥା ମନକୁ ଆସେ। ଏହା ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ଧରି ଆମର ପ୍ରୟୋଗମୂଳକ ପାଠ; ଉତ୍ସ ଅଲଗା ସାମାଜିକ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଦେଇନାହିଁ। ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ଭୁଲ ନୁହେଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଛାଡ଼କୁ ସବୁବେଳର ଅଧିକାର କରିନେଲେ ସୀମା କେଉଁଠି ରହିବ?
english_summary: In one social reading, an initial concession encourages someone to press for more.
odia_summary: ଥରେ ଛାଡ଼ ପାଇ ଆଉ ଅଧିକ ଚାପ ଦେବାକୁ ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରେ ପଢ଼ିହୁଏ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A colleague agrees to cover one shift. The same coworker then assumes they will cover the following weekend too, without asking. A friend quotes the saying, and the colleague clarifies that the first favour was for one day. This workplace use is editorial, not an attested origin.
